name: Travel Rewards Credit Card
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, and no foreign transaction fees
balance_transfer_fee: 3% for the first 60 days of account opening; 5% after
penalty_apr: Up to 29.99%, based on your creditworthiness
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment; applies indefinitely once triggered
pay_over_time_fee: Monthly fee up to 1.72% of the purchase amount assigned to a BofA Custom Pay Plan

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $1,000 in purchases within the first 90 days of account opening

verdict.text: Solid no-fee travel earner: flat 1.5x, no blackout dates

earn_note: Close to flat: 1.5x everywhere with no caps, plus 3x on travel booked through BofA Travel. Points redeem as a statement credit against any travel purchase (flights, hotels, vacation rentals, baggage fees) and also against dining, including takeout. Enrolled BofA Rewards members get a 10–75% bonus on top of these rates depending on combined deposit/investment balance.

redemption_options.method: Statement credit against travel or dining purchases
Cash: deposit to a Bank of America checking or savings account, Merrill credit, or a check

points.note: Travel and dining statement credits are worth 1¢ a point. Cash is worth 0.6¢ a point and gift card value varies, so use points for travel or dining. Travel credits start at 2,500 points and cover qualifying purchases from the past 12 months. There's no transfer-partner program.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: points redeem directly as a statement credit against travel/dining purchases, or for cash/gift cards.

insurance.detail: Not responsible for fraudulent transactions once reported
Not publicly documented for this card
Not publicly documented for this card
Not publicly documented for this card

protection_note: Bank of America's purchase/travel protection suite (Return Protection, Purchase Security, Auto Rental CDW, trip insurance) is only advertised on the Premium Rewards cards; it isn't published for this card.
rental_note: No auto rental coverage documented publicly for this card as of this writing.

services.name: Intro balance transfer fee
services.detail: 3% for the first 60 days the account is open, then 5% on all future transfers.

services.name: BofA Rewards bonus
services.detail: 10% (Member, under $30k), 25% (Preferred Plus, $30k), 50% (Preferred Honors, $100k), or 75% (Premier, $1M) bonus on points earned, set by your three-month average combined Bank of America and Merrill balance. Needs a BofA personal checking account.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add: flat-rate earning means there's no category math to coordinate across users.

timeline.text: Preferred Rewards became BofA Rewards. The tiers were renamed, existing members moved over automatically, and a 10% Member tier was added. The card bonus is now 10% Member, 25% Preferred Plus, 50% Preferred Honors and 75% Premier. Cards earning a Preferred Rewards bonus before May 1, 2026 keep that bonus for at least six months. Preferred Honors and Premier also picked up subscription credits worth up to $96 and $180 a year.
